In a comparative study using an open-source dataset, MICE-based models are evaluated against other gen…
items.why_zh: 它为数据受限的保险精算提供了可替代的合成数据方案，并给出方法间的实证对比。
items.why_en: It offers alternative synthetic-data routes for data-constrained actuarial work, with empirical comparisons among methods.

items.title_zh: 人类何时该介入？AI 辅助决策中的最优人工调度
items.title_en: When Should Humans Step In? Optimal Human Dispatching in AI-Assisted Decisions
items.summary_zh: AI 系统越来越多地通过给出低成本的“因子级”评估来辅助复杂决策，但这些评估可能带有偏差或并不完整。论文研究“选择性人工评估”问题：在已有 AI 信号的前提下，哪些因子应当被派发给人类专家判断。作者将这种人机协作形式化为因子级的信息获取问题。在平方损失下，最优调度规则最大化一个与上下文相关的收益；在线性模型下，该收益可分解为两个可解释的闭式项。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.13688v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: AI systems increasingly assist decision making by producing cheap factor-level assessments of complex inputs, but these assessments can be biased or incomplete. We study selective human evaluation: given AI signals, which factors should be dispatched to human experts? We formulate this human--AI collaboration problem as a factor-level information-acquisition problem. Under squared loss, the optimal dispatching rule maximizes a contextual reward; under a linear model, this reward admits a closed-form decomposition into two interpretable…
items.why_zh: 它给出了“哪里该由人接手”的可计算规则，有助于在有限专家资源下提升人机协作决策质量。
items.why_en: It yields a computable rule for when humans should take over, helping allocate scarce expert attention in human-AI decisions.

items.title_zh: 非平稳广义线性赌博机与折扣在线镜像下降
items.title_en: Nonstationary Generalized Linear Bandits with Discounted Online Mirror Descent
items.summary_zh: 论文研究非平稳广义线性赌博机（GLB）：期望收益通过非线性链接函数建模，其参数未知且随时间变化。该框架涵盖线性、伯努利和二项等多种收益模型。现有方法大多基于最大似然估计（MLE），借助滑动窗口、重启或折扣机制来应对非平稳性；它们虽能取得统计上高效的遗憾保证，但一般还有额外要求。作者转而提出基于折扣在线镜像下降的方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.25590v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study nonstationary generalized linear bandits (GLBs), where the expected reward is modeled through a nonlinear link function with an unknown time-varying parameter. This framework encompasses a broad class of reward models, including linear, Bernoulli, and binomial rewards. Existing approaches are predominantly based on maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE), using sliding-window, restart, or discounting mechanisms to handle nonstationarity. Although these methods achieve statistically efficient regret guarantees, they generally requir…
items.why_zh: 它把在线镜像下降引入非平稳广义线性赌博机，为动态环境下的决策提供了新的算法思路。
items.why_en: It brings online mirror descent to nonstationary generalized linear bandits, offering a new algorithmic angle for decision-making in changing environments.

items.title_zh: 多模态大模型在跨域组织学相似度判断上超越病理基础模型
items.title_en: Multimodal LLMs Outperform Pathology Foundation Models in Cross-Domain Histological Similarity
items.summary_zh: 该研究关注病理基础模型的跨域泛化问题：这些在数百万组织切片上训练的最先进模型，在跨切片或跨机构比较时，往往无法保持组织相似性。作者提出一个相对相似度框架，并作为 MOSAIC（跨机构与队列的模型相似度评估）基准对外发布，据此评估了 17 个模型。结果显示，并非以病理基础模型为目标训练的通用多模态大模型，在跨域组织学相似度判断上持续优于这些专用模型。这一发现对医学影像 AI 的评估方式与专用模型的必要性提出了新的思考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32876v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: State-of-the-art pathology foundation models, trained on millions of histology tiles, can fail to preserve tissue similarity when comparisons cross slide or institution boundaries. We show that general-purpose multimodal LLMs, without being trained as pathology foundation models, consistently outperform these specialized models in cross-domain histological similarity judgments. Using a relative similarity framework that we release as the MOSAIC (Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts) benchmark, we evaluate 17 model…
items.why_zh: 它表明通用多模态模型可能比专用病理基础模型具备更强的跨机构泛化能力，对医学 AI 的评测与建模路线有直接影响。
items.why_en: It suggests general-purpose multimodal models may generalize better across institutions than specialized pathology foundation models, with direct implications for medical AI evaluation and modeling strategy.

items.title_zh: 把神经动力学理解为“量子化单元”的组合
items.title_en: Neural Dynamics as the Composition of Quantized Units
items.summary_zh: 深度学习通常在两个层面被解释：宏观层面通过缩放定律总结损失的整体趋势，微观层面则聚焦神经元、特征与电路。如何把这两个层面连接起来，理解基本计算如何组合并共同塑造宏观行为，是核心难题。为此，作者研究了一种中间抽象，把训练过程描述为对“quanta（量子）”的有序获取：这些可复用的计算是突然获得的，并在样本上以二元方式激活。该框架旨在弥合微观机制与宏观行为之间的解释鸿沟。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32487v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep learning is commonly interpreted at two levels: the macroscopic, through aggregate trends in loss summarized by scaling laws, and the microscopic, through neurons, features, and circuits. A central challenge is understanding how these levels connect, so that we can explain how elementary computations compose and collectively shape macroscopic behavior. To this end, we study an intermediate abstraction in which training is described as the ordered acquisition of quanta: reusable computations acquired suddenly and binary-activated across examp…
items.why_zh: 它为连接神经网络的微观机制与宏观缩放行为提供了一个新的中间层解释框架。
items.why_en: It offers a new intermediate-level framework linking microscopic neural mechanisms to macroscopic scaling behavior.

items.title_zh: 函数级漏洞评分更多反映评测协议而非模型本身
items.title_en: A Function-Level Vulnerability Score Measures Flag Rate More Than the Model: Protocol Effects on Paired Benchmarks
items.summary_zh: 语言模型越来越多地被当作漏洞检测器来评估，但论文之间报告的分数差异很大。作者在固定模型输出的前提下，测量评测协议能解释多少这种差异。实验采用配对测试：模型必须标记出有漏洞的函数，并在修复提交后清除该函数的对应版本。研究者逐个改变已发表评测中做法不一的三个选择——指标、判定提取方式和输出预算——并在五个公开配对数据集上评估了七个前沿模型和大型开源模型。结果表明，函数级漏洞评分在很大程度上衡量的是标记率与协议设定，而非模型能力本身。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32890v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models are increasingly evaluated as vulnerability detectors, and scores reported for similar models differ widely between papers. We measured how much of that difference evaluation protocol accounts for, with model outputs held fixed. In a paired test, a model must flag a vulnerable function and clear its version after a fixing commit. Three choices that published evaluations make differently were varied one at a time: metric, verdict extraction and output budget. Seven frontier and large open models were evaluated on five released pair…
items.why_zh: 它提醒漏洞检测评测中的分数差异可能来自协议而非模型，呼吁更规范、可比的评测标准。
items.why_en: It warns that score differences in vulnerability-detection evaluations may stem from protocol rather than models, underscoring the need for standardized, comparable benchmarks.

items.title_zh: 类型化决策模型：早期证据审计与评测清单
items.title_en: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
items.summary_zh: 类型化决策模型（TDM）不生成文本，而是返回调用者自定义选项上的概率分布。TypeSafe 于 2026 年 9 月 15 日发布了商用类型化决策模型 Jev，随后数天内就出现了一批评测与复现工作。作者回顾了 9 月 19 日至 24 日间发布的 28 篇论文，并将其发现与此前关于标签概率分类、约束解码、重排序、校准和模型级联的研究相联系。在这批早期文献中，类型化读出本身尚未展现出独立的优势。文章据此提出了一份早期证据审计与评测清单。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32160v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) return probability distributions over caller-defined options without generating text. TypeSafe released Jev, a commercial typed decision model, on 15 September 2026, and a small body of evaluation and replication work appeared within days. We review 28 papers posted between 19 and 24 September and relate their findings to earlier work on label-probability classification, constrained decoding, reranking, calibration, and model cascades. In this early literature, the typed readout itself has not shown an independent a…
items.why_zh: 它为快速涌现的 TDM 方向提供了首份证据审计，指出尚无证据表明类型化读出本身带来独立收益。
items.why_en: It provides an early evidence audit of the fast-emerging TDM field, noting no evidence yet that the typed readout itself confers an independent advantage.

items.title_zh: USAI-Quant：面向建成环境的视觉语言模型定量推理基准
items.title_en: USAI-Quant: A Quantitative Reasoning Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Built Environments
items.summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）已成为城市与空间 AI 的重要范式，但当前最先进的 VLM 在遥感影像的定量推理上仍显吃力。现有基准与算法主要基于定性的视觉问答（VQA），难以揭示 VLM 在建成环境指标上的定量推理能力。为填补这一空白，作者提出定量城市与空间 AI 基准（USAI-Quant），这是首个专为建成环境定量推理设计的基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32813v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for urban and spatial AI. However, current state-of-the-art large VLMs still struggle with quantitative reasoning on remote sensing imagery. Existing benchmarks and algorithms are predominantly based on qualitative Visual Question Answering (VQA), providing limited insights into the quantitative reasoning capabilities of VLMs for built environment metrics. To address this gap, we develop Quantitative Urban and Spatial AI benchmark (USAI-Quant), the first benchmark designed…
items.why_zh: 它填补了遥感与城市 AI 中定量评估的空白，为衡量 VLM 的真实空间推理能力提供标准化手段。
items.why_en: It fills a gap in quantitative evaluation for remote sensing and urban AI, offering a standard way to measure VLMs' real spatial reasoning ability.

items.title_zh: 用于动态特征选择的超网络方法
items.title_en: Hypernetworks for Dynamic Feature Selection
items.summary_zh: 动态特征选择（DFS）是一种在预算约束下为每个样本依次获取特征的机器学习框架。由于可能的特征获取路径数量呈指数增长，即便特征空间规模适中，DFS 模型也必须在拟合具体场景与保持整体性能之间权衡。本文分析了现有 DFS 方法在达到最优解上的结构性局限，并提出基于超网络的 Hyper-DFS 方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.12278v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dynamic feature selection (DFS) is a machine learning framework in which features are acquired sequentially for individual samples under budget constraints. The exponential growth in the number of possible feature acquisition paths forces a DFS model to balance fitting specific scenarios against maintaining general performance, even when the feature space is moderate in size. In this paper, we study the structural limitations of existing DFS approaches to achieve an optimal solution. Then, we propose \textsc{Hyper-DFS}, a hypernetwork-based D…
items.why_zh: 它针对动态特征选择中路径爆炸带来的结构性瓶颈提出超网络解法，有望提升有限预算下的选择效率。
items.why_en: It tackles the structural bottleneck of path explosion in dynamic feature selection with a hypernetwork approach, potentially improving efficiency under limited budgets.

items.title_zh: 告别 K-means：面向高效多向量检索的单阶段稀疏编码
items.title_en: No More K-means: Single-Stage Sparse Coding for Efficient Multi-Vector Retrieval
items.summary_zh: 以 ColBERT 为代表的多向量检索（MVR）模型通过保留细粒度的 token 级交互，刷新了检索精度基准，但这种粒度带来了严峻的存储与检索效率瓶颈。为应对十亿级 token 向量的内存占用与计算开销，当前最先进系统不得不依赖激进的降维和复杂聚类（如 K-means）。作者指出这种折衷带来两方面关键局限，并提出单阶段稀疏编码方法，以摆脱对聚类的依赖。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.30120v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multi-vector retrieval (MVR) models, exemplified by ColBERT, have established new benchmarks in retrieval accuracy by preserving fine-grained token-level interactions. However, this granularity imposes prohibitive storage and retrieval efficiency bottlenecks: to manage the immense memory footprint and computational overhead of billion-scale token vectors, state-of-the-art systems are forced to rely on aggressive dimension reduction and complex clustering (e.g., K-means). This compromise introduces two critical limitations: excessive ind…
items.why_zh: 它试图在保持多向量检索精度的同时消除 K-means 等聚类带来的索引与精度损失，对大规模检索系统意义重大。
items.why_en: It aims to preserve multi-vector retrieval accuracy while removing the indexing cost and precision loss of clustering such as K-means, which matters greatly for large-scale retrieval systems.

items.title_zh: LACUNA：评测大模型遗忘定位精度的测试平台
items.title_en: LACUNA: A Testbed for Evaluating Localization Precision for LLM Unlearning
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型会记住训练数据中的敏感信息，包括个人可识别信息（PII），因此亟需可靠的事后移除方法。机器遗忘被视为有前景的解决方案，当前最先进方法多采用“先定位、后遗忘”的范式，针对特定模型参数进行修改。然而现有基准只在输出层面评估遗忘效果，无法回答一个关键问题：遗忘究竟是真的从模型参数中抹除了知识，还是仅仅将其混淆。LACUNA 正是为评测遗忘的定位精度而构建的测试平台。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.02513v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: LLMs memorize sensitive training data, including personally identifiable information (PII), creating a pressing need for reliable post hoc removal methods. Unlearning has emerged as a promising solution, with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods often following a localize-first, unlearn-second paradigm that targets specific model parameters. However, existing benchmarks evaluate unlearning solely at the output level, leaving open the question of whether unlearning truly erases knowledge from a model's parameters or merely obfuscates it, a co…
items.why_zh: 它把遗忘评测从输出层面推进到参数定位层面，有助于判断遗忘是真正抹除还是仅表面遮蔽。
items.why_en: It advances unlearning evaluation from output-level to parameter-localization level, helping distinguish genuine erasure from mere obfuscation.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾版“AI工具箱”：从TileLang到通信库，国产算力生态再进一步
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources an Ascend 'AI Toolbox': From TileLang to Communication Libraries
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾版“AI工具箱”：从TileLang到通信库，国产算力生态再进一步 搜狐网
items.summary_en: According to Sohu, DeepSeek has open-sourced an "AI toolbox" for Huawei's Ascend platform, spanning components from TileLang to communication libraries. The release is presented as another step forward for China's domestic compute ecosystem.
items.why_zh: 头部模型厂商开源昇腾适配工具链，有望降低国产算力上的模型开发门槛并加速生态成熟。
items.why_en: A leading model developer open-sourcing Ascend tooling could lower the barrier to building on domestic compute and speed ecosystem maturity.

items.title_zh: 对标英伟达CUDA！DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件 性能逼近硬件上限
items.title_en: Taking on NVIDIA CUDA: DeepSeek's Open-Source Ascend Components Approach Hardware Limits
items.summary_zh: 对标英伟达CUDA！DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件 性能逼近硬件上限 驱动之家
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced base components for Huawei's Ascend platform in a move framed as a challenge to NVIDIA's CUDA, with reports saying performance approaches the hardware's limits. The components cover low-level compute, communication and compilation capabilities and correspond to counterparts on NVIDIA's platform.
items.why_zh: 若能逼近硬件上限，意味着国产算力平台在极端性能利用效率上具备与 CUDA 生态竞争的可能。
items.why_en: Performance approaching hardware limits would suggest domestic accelerators can compete with the CUDA ecosystem on efficiency.

items.summary_en: ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao has officially launched a one-stop travel service, letting users handle travel-related needs directly within the app. The move extends the assistant beyond Q&A and content generation into real-world service scenarios. Details on covered services and partners were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: AI 助手正从“聊天工具”转向可直接完成交易与服务的入口，出行是高频率、高价值的落地场景。
items.why_en: AI assistants are shifting from chat tools into transactional service gateways, and travel is a high-frequency, high-value use case.

items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Ascend Infrastructure Components to Match Its NVIDIA Stack

items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced infrastructure components for Huawei's Ascend computing platform, mirroring the components it previously released for NVIDIA platforms. The move signals dual-track support for both Ascend and NVIDIA hardware stacks. It lowers the barrier for Chinese developers running DeepSeek models on domestic chips.
items.why_zh: 头部模型厂商公开适配国产算力，有助于削弱对英伟达生态的单点依赖。
items.why_en: A leading model maker openly supporting domestic Chinese silicon helps reduce dependence on NVIDIA's ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 【每日瞰AI】DeepSeek Harness推出桌面端预览版；OpenAI将恢复200美元Pro订阅，但用量减半
items.title_en: DeepSeek Harness Desktop Preview; OpenAI to Restore $200 Pro Plan With Halved Usage
items.summary_zh: 【每日瞰AI】DeepSeek Harness推出桌面端预览版；OpenAI将恢复200美元Pro订阅，但用量减半 电子工程专辑
items.summary_en: Two updates in this AI roundup: DeepSeek released a desktop preview of its Harness tool, and OpenAI plans to restore its $200 Pro subscription with usage halved. The news touches on both developer tooling and AI service pricing and quota policy.
items.why_zh: 订阅配额缩减与本地化工具发布，反映出 AI 厂商在算力成本与用户留存之间的再平衡。
items.why_en: Shrinking subscription quotas and localized tooling show vendors rebalancing compute costs against user retention.

items.title_zh: 法拉第未来：机器人工厂目标年底前投入运营
items.title_en: Faraday Future Targets Year-End Launch for Its Robot Factory
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，今日，法拉第未来在匹兹堡举办的国际智能机器人与系统大会（IROS）期间，举行了“Built in USA”发布及合作伙伴招募大会下半场、“四核全智”生态上游伙伴及产业生态共建专场暨 FFR（现 AIxC）拟独立上市及 FFAI 战略升级发布活动。 法拉第未来公布了“Built in USA”加速计划第二阶段进一步执行方案：加快推进 Next Futurist 和 Next Aegis 系列产品下线，启动向 FCC 申请机器人产品有条件批准，推进供应链、合规认证和制造产能建设；目标于今年年底前将机器人工厂投入运营，并于 2027 年第一季度实现首款新 EAI 本体产品下线。 法拉第未来还称，FFAI 已与 AIxC（即将更名为 FFR）签署非约束性条款，拟由 AIxC 以全股票方式收购 FFAI 的机器人资产及业务，估值约 2 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 13.44 亿元人民币） 。FFR 目标成为美股“四核全智”Pure-Play 机器人生态公司第一股。
items.summary_en: At IROS in Pittsburgh, Faraday Future laid out phase two of its 'Built in USA' acceleration plan: ramping Next Futurist and Next Aegis products, seeking conditional FCC approval for robot products, and building supply chain and manufacturing capacity, with the robot factory targeted to operate by year-end and first new EAI product off the line in Q1 2027. FFAI also signed non-binding terms with AIxC (to be renamed FFR) for an all-stock acquisition of its robotics assets at roughly $200 million.
items.why_zh: 这是又一家车企把机器人业务分拆上市，反映具身智能资产正被资本化运作。
items.why_en: Another automaker is spinning out robotics into a listed vehicle, showing embodied-AI assets being financialized.

items.summary_en: Doubao has added travel service capabilities and a dedicated 'Travel with Doubao' entry point inside the app. The move shows the assistant integrating vertical, scenario-specific entry points beyond general-purpose chat. Specific service scope and partners were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 在 AI 助手同质化竞争下，谁能嵌入真实交易场景，谁就更可能留住用户。
items.why_en: As AI assistants converge in capability, embedding into real transaction scenarios is what retains users.

items.why_zh: 组件层面的对齐让国产算力平台更易承接主流大模型生态。
items.why_en: Component-level parity makes domestic Chinese compute platforms more viable hosts for mainstream model ecosystems.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源华为昇腾基础组件 与英伟达平台组件一一对应 搜狐网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced base components for Huawei's Ascend platform spanning compute, communication and compilation. Reports say they map one-to-one with components on NVIDIA's platform, which should make migration and adaptation easier for developers.
items.why_zh: 与英伟达组件一一对应的开源基础组件，是国产算力生态走向可用、好用的一步。
items.why_en: Open-source components matching NVIDIA's one-to-one mark a step toward a usable and competitive domestic compute ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 豪威推出常开型视觉 AI 协处理器 OAX7700，停车监控方案仅需 3% 功耗
items.title_en: OmniVision Unveils Always-On Vision AI Coprocessor OAX7700 With 3% Power Draw
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，豪威 (OmniVision) 近日发布常开型视觉 AI 协处理器 OAX7700。这一芯片集成 NPU 单元， 基于其构建的停车监控系统仅需市面现有方案 3% 的功耗 。 OAX7700 具备人体检测、人和物体识别、距离测算等边缘 AI 能力，可将环视系统等现有车载外摄像头方案 升级为基于超低功耗边缘 AI 的停车监控系统 。 设备处于常开模式时，摄像头以极低功耗不间断监测车辆周边环境；一旦检测到事件触发信号，可即刻切换至正常工作模式。摄像头将录制 5~10 秒预录视频，交由电子控制单元进一步分析核验事件，必要时触发报警。 IT之家了解到，OAX7700 采用 5.5×3.5 (mm) 的 60 引脚 BGA 封装，堆叠 PSRAM 与闪存。其现已出样，计划于 2027 年第 1 季度实现量产。
items.summary_en: OmniVision launched the OAX7700, an always-on vision AI coprocessor with an integrated NPU that lets parking-monitoring systems run at just 3% of the power of existing solutions. It supports on-device human detection, object recognition and distance measurement, upgrading surround-view cameras into ultra-low-power edge AI sentries that pre-record 5-10 seconds of video on event triggers. The 5.5×3.5mm 60-pin BGA chip is sampling now, with mass production set for Q1 2027.
items.why_zh: 把视觉 AI 的功耗压到 3%，是常开型车载感知能否大规模落地的关键门槛。
items.why_en: Cutting vision-AI power to 3% is the key threshold for always-on automotive sensing to scale.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件，涵盖对标英伟达CUDA的高级语言编译工具
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Ascend Components, Including a CUDA-Rivaling High-Level Compiler
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件，涵盖对标英伟达CUDA的高级语言编译工具 finance.sina.com.cn
items.summary_en: DeepSeek's open-sourced Ascend components include a high-level language compiler positioned as a counterpart to NVIDIA's CUDA. The aim is to let developers write code in a CUDA-like manner and run it on Ascend hardware, reducing cross-platform migration costs. It mirrors DeepSeek's earlier component work on NVIDIA platforms.
items.why_zh: 编译工具是软件生态的入口，对标 CUDA 意味着国产算力正试图补齐最难的软件层短板。
items.why_en: Compilers are the gateway to a software ecosystem; rivalling CUDA means domestic silicon is tackling its hardest software-layer gap.

items.title_zh: 福田汽车 2030 年锚定百万销量目标，新能源占比 50%
items.title_en: Foton Motor Unveils 15th Five-Year Plan: 1 Million Sales by 2030, 50% New Energy
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，福田汽车 9 月 29 日发布“十五五”战略发展规划， 明确 2030 年整车 100 万辆销量的核心战略目标 。 国际化方面，福田汽车 2026 年 1 至 8 月海外销量近 15 万辆，同比增长 44.3%；截至目前，企业海外累计总销量突破 139 万辆，产品服务覆盖全球 140 多个国家和地区，出口销量连续 15 年位居中国商用车行业首位。 “十五五”期间，福田汽车将持续推进国际化战略升级，全面实现从传统“产品出海”向“体系出海、智造出海、品牌出海”跨越，全力保障 2030 年海外销量 40 万辆、销量占比 40% 的战略目标落地。 IT之家获悉，福田汽车依托自研爱易科三电技术平台，攻坚电池、电驱、电控及氢燃料核心零部件等关键领域，布局新能源零部件专属产业基地，提升电池 PACK、电驱桥、整车控制器等核心模块自制率， 支撑 2030 年新能源销量 50 万辆、销量占比 50% 的战略目标落地 。 在智能驾驶领域，福田汽车将持续推进 L2-L3 级智能驾驶算法全栈自研 ，实现高速领航、智能避障、自适应巡航等功能规模化装车，全面覆盖长途干线物流、城市配送等核心商用场景。同时在港口码头、矿区园区、末端物流等封闭限定场景，持续突破 L4 级高阶自动驾驶技术，迭代优化无人牵引、无人环卫、无人配送、智能巴士等无人装备解决方案，持续扩大商业化示范运营范围，…
items.summary_en: Foton Motor released its 15th Five-Year Plan on Sept 29, targeting 1 million vehicle sales by 2030, with new energy models making up 500,000 units (50%) and overseas sales reaching 400,000 units (40%). It reported nearly 150,000 overseas sales in Jan-Aug 2026, up 44.3% year on year, and cumulative overseas sales above 1.39 million units. The plan also emphasizes in-house battery, e-drive and e-control technology plus L2-L3 autonomous driving development and L4 pilots in closed scenarios.
items.why_zh: 这显示中国商用车龙头正把增长押注在新能源与出海两条主线上，并同步推进智能驾驶自研。
items.why_en: It shows a leading Chinese commercial-vehicle maker betting its growth on electrification and overseas expansion while pursuing in-house autonomous driving.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件：与英伟达平台一一对应
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Ascend Foundation Components, One-to-One with NVIDIA Platform
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源昇腾基础组件：与英伟达平台一一对应 砍柴网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced foundational components for Huawei's Ascend platform, designed to correspond one-to-one with NVIDIA's platform components. The move aims to lower the barrier for developers migrating from NVIDIA's ecosystem to Ascend.
items.why_zh: 这有助于打破英伟达在 AI 算力生态的垄断，促进国产 AI 芯片的软硬件协同发展。
items.why_en: It helps break NVIDIA's monopoly in the AI computing ecosystem and promotes the coordinated development of domestic AI chips and software.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 开源昇腾基础组件 搜狐网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced base components for Huawei's Ascend platform, according to Sohu. Details on the components' functions and scope have not yet been disclosed.
items.why_zh: 开源基础组件有助于降低开发者使用国产昇腾算力运行大模型的门槛。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing base components can lower the barrier to running large models on domestic Ascend compute.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 开源昇腾基础组件
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Base Components for Huawei Ascend
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 开源昇腾基础组件 金融界
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has open-sourced base components for Huawei's Ascend (昇腾) AI chip platform, according to a report by Jinrongjie. The release opens DeepSeek's low-level adaptation and tooling for Ascend hardware to the developer community, enabling models to be deployed and optimized on domestic AI chips. Details such as the exact components, license and supported model versions have not yet been disclosed.
items.why_zh: 头部开源模型厂商主动补齐国产昇腾芯片的底层组件，有助于壮大国产算力的软件生态。
items.why_en: A leading open-source model developer filling in low-level components for Huawei's Ascend chips could help strengthen the software ecosystem around China's domestic AI compute.
